manual.title: Hub settings
manual.description: Configure one hub for this room. Leave Default Device ID blank for no default; otherwise Default Remote is created automatically.

discovery_failed.title: Discovery unavailable
discovery_failed.description: Check that MQTT is configured and connected, then retry or enter the ID manually.

discovered.title: Select discovered hub
discovered.description: Select a hub detected from valid button traffic, or enter its ID manually. Already configured hubs are excluded.

add_device.title: Add virtual device
add_device.description: Numeric device IDs are unique within this room. New devices have no custom mappings.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm device removal
confirm_remove.description: Remove {device}? Device automations referencing this device may stop working. Its custom mappings will be deleted. Unconfigured-device events will still be emitted.

default.title: Change Default Device
default.description: The default uses 66 read-only built-in mappings. Custom mappings stay stored and return when the device is no longer the default.

mappings.title: Choose custom device
mappings.description: Default-device mappings are read-only and excluded from this list.

set_mapping.title: Add or edit mapping
set_mapping.description: Enter an existing key ID to rename its button. Existing mappings: {mappings}

clear_mappings.title: Clear Button Mappings
clear_mappings.description: Clear every custom mapping for this device? Numeric automation triggers continue to work.

progress.discover: Press buttons on your Sofabaton remote. Listening to MQTT traffic for 15 seconds…

error.invalid_mqtt_id: Enter a literal MQTT topic ID without /, +, # or a leading $.
error.duplicate_device: This room already has that device ID.
error.duplicate_mqtt: That MQTT ID is already configured in another room.
error.no_devices: Add a virtual device first. Submit to return.
error.no_custom_devices: Add a non-default virtual device to edit custom mappings. Submit to return.
error.no_mappings: This device has no custom mappings. Submit to return.

abort.invalid_mqtt_id: Enter a literal MQTT topic ID without /, +, # or a leading $.
abort.duplicate_device: This room already has that device ID.
abort.duplicate_mqtt: That MQTT ID is already configured in another room.
abort.mqtt_required: Configure the Home Assistant MQTT integration first.
abort.no_custom_devices: Add a non-default virtual device to edit custom mappings.
abort.invalid_device: This virtual device is no longer configured.
abort.no_mappings: This device has no custom mappings.
abort.settings_changed: Settings changed in another window. Reopen Configure and try again.
